mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 950K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.0% and remains there for 2 consecutive months, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.10) when UNRATE is below 6.0% for 2+ months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a single month, indicating supply chain resilience, tends to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC for this mechanism is consistently below 0.01 over a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) above 850K units and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% in a month, indicating managed inflation, tends to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with inflation management
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the general trend of payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, as a broad indicator of labor market health, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Long-term (5-year) correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a rapid GDP increase (GDPC1) by more than 2.5% in a quarter, signaling strong demand rebound, tends to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in post-shock recovery periods are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 grows by more than 2.5% QoQ.
